english_outline.section_1_main_conclusion: Western Digital beat FY2027 Q1 consensus on EPS and revenue, yet the stock fell. Investing.com attributes the selloff to valuation and cycle-end fears, not to weak fundamentals.
english_outline.section_2_business_changes: Exabyte shipments rose 22% year over year to 248 EB. Cloud was 88% of sales. Revenue rose on a favorable pricing environment. Morgan Stanley cited spot HDD transactions at 2-5x contracted prices.
english_outline.section_3_expectations: Consensus FY2027 EPS is $20.85 versus $10.22 in FY2026. EPS consensus rose 5.8% in 30 days and 14.8% in 90 days. Quarterly EPS is seen climbing from $4.76 to $6.84 by Sep 2027.
english_outline.section_4_pricing: Shares fell after the print. Investing.com reports a 1M return of -25.15%. Morgan Stanley cut its target to $643 from $676 on lower multiples, not lower earnings, and called the cycle-end pricing overly punitive.
english_outline.section_5_next_verification: Next earnings is tentatively Feb 3, 2027, with consensus EPS $4.76 and revenue $4.55B. HDD price per TB, HAMR and 40TB+ drive ramp, hyperscaler long-term agreements, and supply versus demand are the key items to watch.

reader_questions: 稿件把官方季度（2026-07-04 至 2026-10-02）与媒体所称的 FY2027 Q1 混用，这两个口径是同一报告期吗？
稿件称“营业利润率约为 46.7%、净利润率约为 40.6%”，这两个比率在来源中是否有直接披露，还是由稿件自行计算？
稿件把“248 EB 出货量、云占 88%、现货价为合约价 2–5 倍”与官方财务数据并列陈述，这些指标的来源与确定性是否相同？
checks: 核查：官方来源的期间为 2026-07-04 至 2026-10-02，媒体文章称公司于 2026 年 10 月 22 日发布 FY2027 Q1 财报，两者指向同一报告期，但稿件标题写作“2026Q4”与正文“FY2027 第一财季”并存，属口径混用，需统一为来源可支持的表述。
核查：官方来源仅提供营收、营业利润、净利润、经营性现金流四项金额，未提供利润率；46.7% 与 40.6% 系稿件用金额相除得出，来源中无此披露，应删除或明确标注为自行计算。
核查：248 EB、云占 88%、现货价 2–5 倍均出自媒体文章，其中现货价倍数明确归属摩根士丹利；官方来源不含这些指标。稿件将其与官方数据并列而未区分来源层级，需分别标注。
